title: Reporting Obligation
description: Period-level status joining what reporting was expected to any produced immutable revisions and delivery materializations. An obligation exists before its first revision or webhook, making missing-first-report detection possible. All nested revisions and materializations MUST match this obligation's authenticated caller/account, configuration generation, report definition, feed, period, and scope.

schedule.description: Resolved immutable schedule generation that created this obligation.

destination_ref.description: Resolved caller/account-bound destination or recipient binding for this obligation.

production_status.description: Whether any revision has been produced for this obligation. published includes zero-row revisions.

revision_count.description: Number of revision records for this obligation in the consistent ledger snapshot.

materialization_count.description: Number of materialization records for this obligation's revisions in the consistent ledger snapshot.

successful_materialization_count.description: Number of available/delivered verified materializations in the consistent ledger snapshot.

resource_retained_until.description: Minimum time through which at least one verified materialization for a completed obligation remains readable.

x-adcp-validation.nested_identity: Every revision and materialization ledger record associated with this obligation MUST equal its account_id, delivery_config_id, delivery_config_version, destination_ref, report_definition_id, feed_purpose, reporting_profile, period, and applicable media_buy_ids; each materialization reporting_revision_id MUST name an associated revision.
x-adcp-validation.complete_finality: complete requires a published revision at required_finality and at least one verified readable materialization for that revision through resource_retained_until. A snapshot-required pacing obligation may therefore become complete from a snapshot revision.
x-adcp-validation.revision_chain: Supersession MUST be acyclic, remain within this logical slice, and every supersedes_reporting_revision_id MUST name the immediately prior retained revision.
x-adcp-validation.record_counts: revision_count, materialization_count, and successful_materialization_count MUST equal the complete associated record totals for this obligation in ledger_snapshot_id, even when records appear on different pages.
